Question 10
?

Which of the following sets of parametric equations, defined for t∈(−∞,∞), generate the horizontal parabola given by the Cartesian equation (y−2)2=16(x+6)?

a
x+2=t2,y−6=2t
b
x+6=4t2,y−2=8t
c
x−6=8t2,y+2=4t
d
x−2=4t2,y+6=2t
e
x+6=2t2,y−2=4t
